#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int requiredLength = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < requiredLength) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        bi[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    auto transform = [](vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 0;
        while ((1 << bits) < n) bits++;
        
        vector<int> rev(n, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << (bits - 1));
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (i < rev[i]) {
                swap(re[i], re[rev[i]]);
                swap(im[i], im[rev[i]]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cosTable(half), sinTable(half);
            double sign = inverse ? -1 : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * sign;
                cosTable[i] = cos(angle);
                sinTable[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double wReal = cosTable[j];
                    double wImag = sinTable[j];
                    double uReal = re[i + j];
                    double uImag = im[i + j];
                    double vReal = re[i + j + half] * wReal - im[i + j + half] * wImag;
                    double vImag = re[i + j + half] * wImag + im[i + j + half] * wReal;
                    
                    re[i + j] = uReal + vReal;
                    im[i + j] = uImag + vImag;
                    re[i + j + half] = uReal - vReal;
                    im[i + j + half] = uImag - vImag;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };
    
    transform(ar, ai, false);
    transform(br, bi, false);
    
    vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> tmpR(size, 0.0), tmpI(size, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        tmpR[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        tmpI[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    transform(resR, resI, true);
    transform(tmpR, tmpI, true);
    
    vector<int> output(requiredLength);
    for (int i = 0; i < requiredLength; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(resR[i]);
        long long bb = llround(tmpR[i]);
        long long cc = llround(resI[i]);
        output[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        poly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            result = multiply(result, poly, MOD);
        }
        exponent >>= 1;
        if (exponent == 0) break;
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
